title: Credo (Palestrina, Missa Benedicta es)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Benedicta es, Credo, 1565. 6 voices (Discantus, Contratenor 1, Contratenor 2, Tenor, Bassus 1, Bassus 2), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0015_3); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
